import nanosurf, os, time

# Initialize the AFM system
spm = nanosurf.SPM()  # Adjust class if needed for the specific instrument
app = spm.application

# Access relevant objects
scan = app.Scan
opmode = app.OperatingMode
zctrl = app.ZController

# ----- Scan configuration -----

scan.ImageHeight = 10e-6  # 10 µm in meters
scan.Points = 128         # points per line

# scan.CenterPosY = 0.0

# Many Nanosurf systems expose a "Gentle" or "LowForce" mode via the OperatingMode object.
# The exact enum name can vary; we attempt the most common ones.
try:
    opmode.Mode = "Gentle"  # string enum
except Exception:
    try:
        opmode.Mode = "LowForce"
    except Exception:
        # Fallback: use the default contact mode but reduce setpoint and gains
        zctrl.SetPoint = 0.2  # lower set‑point (fraction of full range)
        zctrl.PGain = 500    # reduced proportional gain
        zctrl.IGain = 500    # reduced integral gain

# ----- Start the scan -----
# The Scan.Start() method blocks until the scan finishes and returns the file path.
image_path = scan.Start()

# Ensure the path is absolute (some APIs return relative paths)
image_path = os.path.abspath(image_path)

# Print the path so the outer system can capture it
print(image_path)
